# Solar Thermal Collector (SolarThermalCollector)

> **Class**: `SolarThermalCollector` | **Module**: `energysim.models.renewables` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Solar thermal collector with quadratic Hottel-Whillier-Bliss efficiency.

Steady-state efficiency curve ``eta = eta0 - a1*dT/G - a2*dT^2/G`` (dT =
T_in - T_amb, G = irradiance on the collector plane); no thermal mass, no
incidence-angle modifier. Validity: G > 10 W/m2, dT 0-100 K.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'SolarThermal'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `area_m2` | `float` | `1000.0` | m2 | Total collector aperture area |
| `eta0` | `float` | `0.8` | 1 | Optical peak efficiency factor |
| `a1_w_m2_k` | `float` | `3.5` | W/m2/K | Linear heat-loss coefficient a1 in W/m2/K (default 3.5) |
| `a2_w_m2_k2` | `float` | `0.015` | W/m2/K2 | Quadratic heat-loss coefficient a2 in W/m2/K2 (default 0.015) |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `G_solar` | W/m2 | Irradiance on the collector plane |
| `T_in` | degC | Inlet heat transfer fluid temperature |
| `T_amb` | degC | Ambient temperature |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_thermal_MW` | MW | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: G > 10 W/m2, dT 0-100 K.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import SolarThermalCollector

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('solarthermalcollector', model=SolarThermalCollector(), outputs=['Q_thermal_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['solarthermalcollector'].tail(2))
```
